label: High contrast
intent: The contrast dial flips. Light: the dark half winds back a touch, then sweeps one full clockwise turn through the inverted split and locks home with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: a deeper wind-up, the half snaps over to the inverted side and holds there a beat (light and dark swapped), then completes the turn, overshoots and settles. The ring never moves; the turn ends on the starting angle.

half.rotate.//: a whole turn renders a hair off 0, so each motion steps back to 0 (the same pixels) after it lands
